selection_reason: Retain the task's preferred fourth-chapter controller and already validated continuous protocol for the whole paired V0 comparison. 0204@10800 is an independently verified obstacle candidate, not silently substituted or pooled with this baseline.
history: persistent single_step; full causal reencoding at frame change using actual past normalized commands
observation_frame: rigid local position/heading with target [500,0]; body velocities/actuators unchanged; progress recomputed using the same current goal
high_level_schedule: one Actor forward at decision t; same-forward features choose target applied after action t at boundary t+1; all three methods share this one-step delay
wind: environment-private SyntheticWindField sampled at physical x_t,t with time-indexed exogenous perturbations, held for one original physical step
admission_policy: Require matched assets, migration parity, finite dynamics, continuous physics, causal memory, feature noninterference and demonstrated navigation. Record all task failures separately; no 100-percent success gate.
limits: Development protocol only, no paper reproduction or universal navigation guarantee. No low-level retraining or weight/normalizer updates.
